topic: Pay Off Credit Cards or Other High Interest Debt
source_evidence: If you’ve got unpaid balances on several credit cards, you should first pay down the card that charges the highest rate.
answer: When you have unpaid balances on several credit cards, prioritize the card with the highest interest rate. Pay as much as you can toward that balance each month while continuing to make the minimum payments on your other cards. Keep focusing on the highest-rate balance until it reaches zero, then turn your attention to the next one. The source gives similar guidance for other high-interest debt of about 8% or above when it offers no tax advantages.
